name: Tile & Stone
summary: A tiles, marble and sanitary shop with a room visualiser, a box calculator, free samples and cash on delivery
about: A multi-page shop for a Pakistani tiles, marble and sanitary ware store in warm stone, charcoal and brass, priced in PKR. Any tile can be laid across a drawn room: the floor is a real perspective plane and re-tiles with a sweep, while the calculator turns square feet into boxes that drop onto pallets. Collections, product pages with stock by showroom, a five-slot samples tray, the bag, cash on delivery or bank transfer checkout with tracking, and a showroom map all work.
how: Open a page from the top bar: Shop (hover for the four collections), Room visualiser, Area calculator, Showrooms, samples or the bag
Filter the shop by material, colour, finish, price per sq ft, anti-slip grip or stock in your city, and sort or search
On a product page pick a size and finish, type your area to see boxes and cost, view it in a room and add it to the bag
In the visualiser choose a room, tap tiles for the floor or wall, switch layout, grout and light, then save the look
Add rooms in the calculator, pick a laying pattern and watch the boxes stack, then add everything to the bag
Check out with cash on delivery or bank transfer, choose a delivery day and follow the order; book a showroom visit
Press Ctrl+K to search everything; reset demo data from the footer
